user_story:
As a user, I want to add and remove elements on the page so that I can dynamically manage the elements displayed. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click the button with text 'Add Element', a new element should appear within the div with id 'elements'. 
2. When I have added an element and then click the button with text 'Add Element' again, another element should appear. 
3. When I click on any of the added elements, that element should be removed. 
4. The URL should remain the same throughout these operations.
